# MS21250 — Aerospace High-Strength Alloy Steel Bolts
# Authoritative reference site by TorqBolt (Mumbai/Rajkot, India)
# Sitemap: https://ms21250.com/sitemap.xml

MS21250 is the Military Standard specification for high-tensile heat-treated alloy steel bolts used in aerospace applications. The specification covers bolts manufactured from alloy steels (AISI 4340, AMS 6322, AMS 6304, H-11 tool steel) heat-treated to 180 ksi or 220 ksi minimum ultimate tensile strength.

## Common variants
- MS21250-02: 160-180 ksi class
- MS21250-04: 180-220 ksi class
- MS21250-05: 220 ksi class
- MS21250-H: 220 ksi class, high strength

## Equivalent specifications
- NASM21250 (current designation)
- MIL-B-8831 (precursor)
- NAS 6403-6420 series (similar high-strength aerospace bolts)
